name: The Whispering Ruins
description: Ancient voices echo from forgotten chambers beneath the city. Something stirs in the darkness.

narrative.intro:
The entrance to the Whispering Ruins yawns before you like the mouth of some great beast. Scholars from the Circle of Mist have reported strange echoes emanating from within - voices speaking in the old tongue, growing louder each night. The Eternal Flame's light barely penetrates the darkness ahead.

As you descend, the temperature drops and the whispers grow clearer. They seem to be... calling your name.

choices.text: Follow the whispers deeper into the ruins
Light a torch and proceed with caution
Recite the Emissary's Ward against spirits

A.text:
The whispers lead you to a hidden chamber where the spirit of an ancient Emissary awaits. They recognize a kindred soul and share fragments of forgotten knowledge before fading. The experience leaves you changed, touched by the wisdom of those who came before.

"Remember us," the spirit whispers. "Remember what we fought for."

B.text:
Your torchlight reveals ancient murals depicting the founding of Emberholm. As you study them, you realize they contain a hidden message - coordinates to a cache of $PYRE left by the original Emissaries! The whispers fade to grateful silence as you honor the past.

You pocket the cache and take careful notes of the murals for the Circle of Mist.

C.text:
The Ward silences the whispers, but also closes the door to whatever secrets they might have revealed. You complete a thorough sweep of the accessible chambers but find nothing of note. The ruins fall silent, perhaps forever.

Some mysteries are best left unsolved... but you can't shake the feeling you missed something important.

lore_connection: The Whispering Ruins predate Emberholm itself, remnants of a civilization that fell when the Eternal Flame first ignited. Some say the spirits trapped within are those who couldn't accept the new order.
